definition: Analyte (measurand) exactly as named in the source publication. Spelling varies between papers; use analyte_id / component from analytes.csv for filtering.
Interfering substance or condition exactly as named in the source publication. Use interferent_id (see interferent_synonyms.csv) for filtering.
Measurement principle, assay brand or method as reported (e.g. CO-oximetry, FPIA, immunoturbidimetry).
Analyser or instrument on which the measurement was made.
Assay generation, kit version or lot where the source reports it.

values: up / down / no change / not reported
definition: Direction of the measurement error caused by the interferent, as reported: up = falsely increased, down = falsely decreased, no change = no detectable effect.

values: up / down / no change / not reported
definition: Direction judged against the criterion used by the source study itself.

values: up / down / no change / not reported
definition: Direction judged against the analytical performance specification selected for this database (aps_percent).
Concentration or dose of the interferent, with the units used by the source. Free text: not directly plottable.
Analyte concentration before or without the interferent, with source units. Free text.
Analyte concentration in the presence of the interferent, with source units. Free text.
Absolute change printed by the source, in the source's units.
Relative change printed by the source, in percent.
Absolute change derived from the baseline and final values in the source.
Relative change in percent derived from the baseline and final values. This is the primary machine-readable effect size (pct_change in the derived build).
The source's own wording for the size of the effect.
The threshold the SOURCE STUDY used to call a bias significant (often a statistical test, sometimes a percentage, often not reported). Not the database APS.
Whether the observed effect exceeds the analytical performance specification selected for this database. The verdict is parsed into aps_verdict in the derived build.
Specimen used (whole blood, serum, plasma, pooled plasma, postmortem blood, body cavity fluid and so on).
How the interference was produced and measured: spiking, in vivo exposure, patient samples, comparison arms.

values: Yes / Partial / Borderline / Unclear / not reported
definition: Appraisal: whether the interferent concentration tested can occur in patients.

values: Appropriate / Partially appropriate / Inappropriate / Unclear / not reported
definition: Appraisal of the study design for an interference claim.

values: Yes / No / Partial / Unclear / not reported
definition: Appraisal of whether the effect matters clinically.

values: Yes / No / Partial / Unclear / not reported
definition: Appraisal of how well the experiment reflects routine practice.
Other biases the source reports or that are evident in it.
Free-text notes recorded during extraction.
Short citation plus the exact locator inside the source (page, table, figure). Often names the source PDF file.
Full bibliographic reference as printed in the source document.

values: DOI or 'not reported in the information source'
definition: Digital Object Identifier of the source publication.
